name: Might Over Magic (CR 7)
body:
A magician was killed here by brute force, leaving a spiteful vestige driven by hatred of the magic that failed him.

XP 3,200; CN haunt (area of 20-ft. radius around the bloodstain); Caster Level 7th; Notice Perception DC 18 (to notice the bloodstain starting to glow); hp 14; Trigger proximity; Reset 1 day

EFFECT

When this haunt is triggered, the vestige creates a version of greater dispel magic that affects the area of the haunt.

DESTRUCTION

If indoors, the floor around the bloodstain must be torn up. If outdoors, a mound must be built over the place. Magic cannot be used to assist with any of this, whether directly or indirectly.
